rows.grounds: optative of causative tarpay from root tṛp

items.question: Which jaggery-buttermilk-honey mixture is prescribed for satisfying the recipient?
items.inference: The verse prescribes satisfying with jaggery-mixed buttermilk and honey-joined substance.
uncertainties: exact recipient and object are not specified in this verse
items.plain_english: Satisfy with buttermilk mixed with jaggery and honey-joined.
